Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck-boost, synchronous), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (GND) on VSON-14.
Re-verify switching frequency (2400 kHz), inductor value (1.5 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (0.5 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
